description: Milgram 實驗中 64 條成功的鏈，最後一站是誰

source.text: Travers & Milgram 1969, An Experimental Study of the Small World Problem, Sociometry 32(4), p. 439–440

facts.quote: Mr. G, who accounted for 16 completions, is a clothing merchant in the target's hometown of Sharon … 10 made contact through a single business associate, and 5 through a second business associate. These three 'penultimate links' together accounted for 48 per cent of the total completions.
